events.title: Corient Private Wealth LP Makes New $390.91 Million Investment in The Home Depot, Inc. $HD
events.summary: Corient Private Wealth LP has made a significant new investment in The Home Depot, Inc., acquiring 7.74 million shares valued at approximately $390.91 million during the second quarter. This investment gives Corient Private Wealth a 0.78% stake in the company, which also recently exceeded quarterly earnings expectations and declared a $2.33 quarterly dividend. Despite institutional confidence and strong financial performance, Home Depot faces challenges from weak DIY demand and high mortgage rates impacting the housing market.

events.title: 10,930 Shares in Affiliated Managers Group, Inc. $AMG Bought by Jupiter Topco LLC
events.summary: Jupiter Topco LLC recently acquired 10,930 shares of Affiliated Managers Group, Inc. (NYSE:AMG) valued at approximately $3.7 million, while institutional investors now own 95.3% of the company's stock. Despite CEO Jay C. Horgen selling a significant portion of his shares, AMG exceeded quarterly earnings and revenue expectations, prompting analysts to maintain a consensus "Buy" rating with an average price target of $370.86.

events.title: 3,716 Shares in The Home Depot, Inc. $HD Bought by Old North State Trust LLC
events.summary: Old North State Trust LLC recently purchased 3,716 shares of The Home Depot, Inc. (NYSE:HD) for approximately $1.311 million in the second quarter. This move comes as other institutional investors have also adjusted their holdings in the company. Despite mixed sentiment influenced by factors like AI tool expansion and strong quarterly results versus concerns over high mortgage rates and weak DIY demand, analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for Home Depot.

events.title: Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management Co. Acquires 4,811 Shares of The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. $GS
events.summary: Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management Co. increased its stake in Goldman Sachs by 5.2% in Q2 2026, acquiring 4,811 shares to bring its total holdings to 97,699 shares valued at $98.81 million. Goldman Sachs reported strong financial results, including EPS of $20.98 and revenue of $20.34 billion, significantly exceeding analyst estimates. The company also raised its quarterly dividend from $4.50 to $5.00 per share, and analysts currently hold a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating with an average price target of $1,062.86.

events.title: Public Employees Retirement System of Ohio Makes New Investment in Reinsurance Group of America, Incorporated $RGA
events.summary: The Public Employees Retirement System of Ohio has acquired a new stake of 30,727 shares, valued at $6.5 million, in Reinsurance Group of America (RGA) during the second quarter. This move comes as RGA reported strong quarterly earnings of $8.89 per share, surpassing analyst estimates, and increased its quarterly dividend. The company maintains a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating from analysts, with institutional investors holding a significant 95.11% of its outstanding shares.

events.title: Royal London Asset Management Ltd. Lowers Stake in Graco Inc. $GGG
events.summary: Royal London Asset Management Ltd. significantly reduced its stake in Graco Inc. by 75.4% during the second quarter, selling 59,102 shares and retaining 19,307 shares valued at $1.46 million. Despite this reduction, other institutional investors increased their positions in Graco, with institutional ownership collectively standing at 93.88%. Graco reported strong quarterly earnings per share (EPS) of $0.91, exceeding estimates, but its revenue of $590.55 million fell short of expectations, though it marked a 3.3% year-over-year increase.

events.title: Jupiter Topco LLC Takes $4.06 Million Position in Murphy USA Inc. $MUSA
events.summary: Jupiter Topco LLC recently acquired a new $4.06 million stake in Murphy USA Inc. (NYSE:MUSA) during the second quarter, purchasing 7,530 shares. This move highlights institutional interest, as such investors now collectively own over 80% of the company. Murphy USA has also shown strong financial performance, beating earnings estimates and increasing its quarterly dividend.

events.title: Nwam LLC Has $2.03 Million Holdings in Bank of America Corporation $BAC
events.summary: Nwam LLC significantly reduced its stake in Bank of America Corporation, selling 46.3% of its holdings, though it still owns 35,676 shares valued at $2.03 million. Other institutional investors showed mixed activity, with some increasing and others initiating positions in BAC. Bank of America recently increased its quarterly dividend and analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average target price of $64.08, despite some mixed sentiment regarding its future outlook.

events.title: Apple, SLB And A Financial Stock: CNBC’s ‘Final Trades’
events.summary: On CNBC’s "Halftime Report Final Trades," experts recommended Apple (AAPL), The Goldman Sachs Group (GS), and SLB N.V. (SLB). Joshua Brown picked Apple following John Ternus's succession as CEO, with Rosenblatt maintaining a Neutral rating and raising its price target. Jason Snipe chose Goldman Sachs, which was upgraded by HSBC, while Stephanie Link recommended SLB due to its acquisition of Kelvion to strengthen its Data Center Solutions business.

events.title: Empowered Funds LLC Invests $3.61 Million in Tactile Systems Technology, Inc. $TCMD
events.summary: Empowered Funds LLC has invested $3.61 million in Tactile Systems Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:TCMD), acquiring 121,116 shares and a 0.53% stake. The medical device company has a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating from analysts with an average price target of $38.40 and reported strong Q2 earnings, beating EPS estimates. Institutional investors collectively hold 83.43% of the company's stock.

events.title: Jack Henry CEO Greg Adelson to Present at Goldman Sachs Conference
events.summary: Jack Henry (Nasdaq: JKHY) announced that its President & CEO, Greg Adelson, will present at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference 2026 on September 9th at 4:05 p.m. ET. A live webcast of the presentation will be available, with replays accessible on the company's investor relations website. Jack Henry is a financial technology company providing solutions to over 7,200 financial institutions.

events.title: NIO (NYSE:NIO) Downgraded to "Neutral" Rating by JPMorgan Chase & Co.
events.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. downgraded NIO (NYSE:NIO) from an "overweight" to a "neutral" rating, setting a $4.50 price target. This downgrade comes as NIO's stock opened lower, trading near its 12-month low, despite reporting $4.73 billion in quarterly revenue, but remaining unprofitable. Analyst consensus on NIO is currently a "Hold" with an average price target of $6.38.

events.title: Why is Bank of America stock rallying today?
events.summary: Bank of America (BAC) stock rose significantly today, driven by its involvement in a 21-institution consortium planning to launch a U.S. dollar-pegged stablecoin for cross-border payments. The positive sentiment was further supported by Bank of America increasing its stake in Scout24 SE, constructive analyst ratings, and a broader market rally fueled by softer U.S. employment data tempering Federal Reserve tightening expectations.

events.title: Waymo seeks more than $3B in first debt deal to fund growth
events.summary: Waymo is seeking over $3 billion in its first debt financing deal, with lenders including Pimco, Blackstone, and Sixth Street Partners. This move aims to diversify Waymo's funding beyond equity markets to support its expansion efforts, which include increasing its fleet and managing rising AI costs. The company plans to finalize this unrated loan soon as it targets 1 million paid weekly rides globally this year.

events.title: What Financial Services Does Mizuho Financial Group (NYSE:MFG) Actually Provide?
events.summary: Mizuho Financial Group (NYSE:MFG) is a major Japanese banking and financial services holding company offering a broad range of services. Its core businesses include deposit-taking, lending, transaction banking, and treasury services, while also extending into capital markets, underwriting, and asset management. This diversified model allows Mizuho to serve both individual and institutional clients across various financial needs, positioning it as a significant global banking institution.

events.title: Corient Private Wealth LP Purchases Shares of 45,177 Western Alliance Bancorporation $WAL
events.summary: Corient Private Wealth LP recently acquired 45,177 shares of Western Alliance Bancorporation, valued at approximately $2.9 million, bringing institutional ownership to 79.15%. The bank reported strong second-quarter earnings, meeting estimates with a 17.7% revenue increase, and maintains a $0.42 quarterly dividend. Despite a "Moderate Buy" consensus from analysts and a target price of $95.47, the stock opened below this target at $77.29.

events.title: Kevin Hern Makes Series of Stock Transactions in Companies Including Adobe and Boeing By Investing.com
events.summary: Representative Kevin Hern has engaged in a series of stock transactions, including selling partial stakes in Adobe Inc. (NASDAQ: ADBE) and Boeing Company (NYSE: BA), as well as shares in other companies like Alcon, Anheuser-Busch Inbev, and Biogen. These transactions were held across the Hern Family Foundation, Hern Family Revocable Trust, and his Traditional IRA. Additionally, Hern made a significant purchase in a Canadian County Oklahoma Educational Facilities Authority bond.

events.title: Goldman Sachs warns investors to expect lower returns over the next year
events.summary: Goldman Sachs' chief global equity strategist Peter Oppenheimer warns investors to expect lower returns for stocks over the next 12 months, in the mid-to-high single-digit percentage range. This comes after a period of phenomenal returns, with the S&P 500 gaining 12% year-to-date in 2026. Oppenheimer attributes this outlook to factors such as a global government bond sell-off and surging crude oil prices, which are pushing yields higher and pressuring stocks.

events.title: The Goldman Sachs Group Forecasts Strong Price Appreciation for Antero Resources (NYSE:AR) Stock
events.summary: The Goldman Sachs Group raised its price target for Antero Resources (NYSE:AR) from $42 to $48, maintaining a "buy" rating and indicating a potential upside of 20.02%. This positive sentiment is echoed by other analysts, resulting in a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating and an average target price of $49.12. Antero Resources, an independent exploration and production company focusing on natural gas, NGLs, and oil in the Appalachian Basin, is significantly owned by institutional investors.

events.title: Yum! Brands completes U.S. sale of Pizza Hut
events.summary: Yum! Brands has finalized the sale of its Pizza Hut division, excluding Mainland China, to LongRange Capital for approximately $1.5 billion, with potential for an additional $75 million earn-out. This transaction, combined with the earlier sale of Pizza Hut in Mainland China to Yum China Holdings, Inc., brings the total sale proceeds to $2.7 billion. Yum! Brands CEO Chris Turner stated that this move allows the company to focus on global growth, digital capabilities, and restaurant economics to deliver long-term shareholder value.

events.title: Waymo taps into debt markets with $3B deal with Pimco, Blackstone - report
events.summary: Waymo, Alphabet Inc.'s autonomous driving unit, is reportedly close to securing its first debt financing of over $3 billion from lenders including Pacific Investment Management Co. and Blackstone Inc. This move to debt financing, advised by Goldman Sachs, comes as Waymo expands its driverless fleet and faces rising AI costs, aiming to operate 1 million paid weekly rides across 20 cities globally this year. The company previously relied on equity funding, raising $16 billion earlier this year at a $126 billion valuation.

events.title: Goldman Sachs Maintains Macerich Co(MAC.US) With Sell Rating, Raises Target Price to $21
events.summary: Goldman Sachs has reiterated its Sell rating on Macerich Co (MAC.US) but has increased its price target for the company to $21. This indicates a continued cautious outlook from Goldman Sachs on Macerich's stock despite the raised target.

events.title: New York-Traded Fund Reveals Ripple as Top Holding, Overtaking Kraken
events.summary: C1 Fund Inc., a New York-traded closed-end fund, has revealed Ripple Labs Inc. as its largest holding for Q2 2026, surpassing Kraken's parent company, Payward, Inc. This development coincides with increased interest in Ripple's shares among traditional market investors and growing institutional exposure to XRP through regulated ETFs. Ripple Labs is also diversifying its financial instruments, indicating a split in investment strategies between direct company shares and token-backed products.

events.title: Yelp to Participate in the Goldman Sachs Communacopia & Technology Conference
events.summary: Yelp Inc. announced that its management will present at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia & Technology Conference on September 9, 2026, at 3:05 p.m. Pacific Time. A live and archived webcast of the presentation will be available on the company's investor relations website for 180 days. Yelp connects people with local businesses through its community-driven platform and AI technologies.

events.title: Goldman Sachs Discloses 3.15% Stake in Qiagen via AFM Filing
events.summary: Goldman Sachs has disclosed a combined real and potential interest of 3.15% in Qiagen's share capital and voting rights, according to a notification from the Dutch regulator AFM. This stake is held through various instruments and entities, including ordinary shares, swaps, options, warrants, and convertible bonds. The disclosure highlights Goldman Sachs as a significant institutional investor in Qiagen, a Netherlands-based life sciences company.

events.title: Goldman Sachs Discloses 2.93% Stake in QIAGEN via Shares and Derivatives
events.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. has reported a 2.93% aggregate stake in QIAGEN (QGEN) through a combination of shares, derivatives, warrants, and convertible bonds, as revealed in an AFM filing. This disclosure indicates Goldman Sachs' indirect real and potential interests, highlighting a notable but non-controlling financial involvement in the company. QIAGEN, a Netherlands-based life sciences company, specializes in sample and assay technologies.

events.title: 121,621 Shares in Bright Horizons Family Solutions Inc. $BFAM Acquired by Legal & General Group Plc
events.summary: Legal & General Group Plc has acquired 121,621 shares of Bright Horizons Family Solutions Inc. (BFAM) during the second quarter, a stake valued at approximately $8.62 million, representing 0.25% of the company. Bright Horizons reported strong quarterly earnings, surpassing analyst expectations with $1.28 EPS and $779.18 million in revenue, a 6.4% year-over-year increase, and maintained its fiscal 2026 EPS guidance. Despite a "Hold" consensus rating and an average price target of $95.88, insider selling activity was also noted.

events.title: Goldman Sachs (GS) Targets 2027 Launch For A USD Stablecoin
events.summary: Goldman Sachs and 21 other global banks plan to launch a regulated, USD-backed stablecoin by 2027. This initiative aims to facilitate cross-border payments, institutional settlements, and broader digital asset market activities, with potential expansion to other fiat currencies. For Goldman Sachs, the stablecoin represents an extension of its existing strengths in finance and a strategy to share development costs and regulatory work within the consortium.

events.title: Betterware De Mexico (NYSE: BWMX) Maintains Activist Majority with 20.28 Million Shares Amid Share Issuance
events.summary: Campalier and Luis German Campos Orozco continue to hold a 51.36% activist majority in Betterware de Mexico (NYSE: BWMX) with 20.28 million shares. This percentage decreased due to a share issuance related to the Tupperware acquisition, not a sale by the activists. Their voting and disposition rights over the shares remain intact, reflecting their maintained influence over the company.

events.title: BOA Acquisition Corp. Class A (BOAS) Shareholding Pattern – Promoters, FIIs & DIIs
events.summary: This article details the shareholding pattern of BOA Acquisition Corp. Class A (BOAS), focusing on institutional ownership. It lists several key institutional shareholders, their percentage of equity, and changes in their holdings as of March and September 2022. The data provides insights into the major institutional investors in the company.
